title: 18-Inch Towel Bar, Solid Brass Wall Mount | Fire Engine Red | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels neatly displayed and easy to grab with a wall-mounted towel bar that brings traditional style to everyday bathroom organization in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Designed as part of the Carolina Collection, it coordinates effortlessly with matching Carolina accessories for a classic, timeless look.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Space-smart installation: Wall mount design frees up floor and vanity space—ideal for smaller baths.
  • Coordinated bathroom design: Pairs with other Carolina Collection pieces for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • Built from solid brass: Brass construction for enduring use.

Specs & Installation
Length: 18 Inch
Overall width: 20
Depth (projection): 2
Height: 3.5
Weight: 2.4 lbs
Mounting: Wall mounted; concealed screw mounting; mounting hardware included
Multiple designer finish options available
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
